image_description: A close-up, slightly angled view of a comic book cover displayed in a rack. The cover features dynamic superhero artwork with a red-costumed character (resembling Spider-Man) and a blue-costumed character in action poses. The background shows other comic books and rack structures, slightly out of focus. The image has a painterly, illustrative style typical of comic art.

artifact_observations.location: Top title banner and background comics
artifact_observations.reasoning: The main title text at the top is stylized but largely illegible/nonsensical upon close inspection. Background comic spines also show gibberish text patterns, typical of AI generation struggling with small print.

Slight 'smearing' or painterly blur at the boundaries between the red and blue costumes, lacking the crisp ink lines expected in high-quality comic prints. Looks more like a digital painting than a printed comic scan.
The anatomy of the blue character's lower leg and foot merges indistinctly with the background/rack structure. The shoe shape is ambiguous and lacks clear definition.
